name: Terminal-first workbench
prompt: Create a high-fidelity flat 1440x900 desktop application UI concept for a standalone native coding-agent workbench named Onionmind. Use a terminal-first Claude Code composition: a narrow session rail, conversational agent log and live terminal side by side, a full-width changes review pane below, and a fixed multiline composer. Show repository, branch, Ollama, Tor, approval, and INFERNO model state. Use restrained warm graphite and charcoal-brown panels, soft bone text, subtle aubergine selection, compact system sans, developer monospace, fine one-pixel seams, and 5-7px radii. No neon, glow, gradients, glass, oversized headings, decorative cards, proprietary marks, or browser chrome. It must look like a real native software screenshot.
